target: forge.sh pr-create (gitlab) — an already-open MR for the head is printed and no second one is created
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_http "GET /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests?source_branch=feat&state=opened" 200 '[{"iid":9,"web_url":"https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/9"}]'
fx_http "POST /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests" 201 '{"iid":10,"web_url":"https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/10"}'
fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title T --body-file body.md; fx_show r
echo "posts=$(fx_nmeth POST)"
fx_reqs
fx_done
